title: Independent periodic band-gap test of halogenated pyridinium lead bromides
difficulty_reasons: Three heavy-element periodic crystals require independently planned convergence and orbital-assignment checks at the stated HSE06 no-SOC primary level, with optional SOC reported separately.
The agent must validate band gaps and band-edge character for each object and test a qualitative structure–gap hypothesis.

data.description: Three experimental parent CIFs and explicit, separate fundamental/framework/same-k electronic observable and relativistic boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Per-crystal fundamental/framework edge and same-k gaps, assignment and stability evidence, separately labeled optical/SOC claims, structural comparison and limitations.
